candidates.title: The Flour That Changed Color
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered flour from the village mill turned gray after each rain before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they cleaned the grinding stones but the next batch was gray again; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized rainwater washed soot from a chimney crack into the grain chute; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they sealed the crack and discarded the contaminated grain, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered a whispering sound disturbed readers beside the library wall before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they closed the windows but the noise continued; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized air passed through a narrow gap behind a loose ventilation grille; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they secured the grille and restored quiet airflow, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Dome That Would Not Follow the Stars
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the observatory dome stopped rotating during a night survey before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they restarted the motor but the dome stalled at the same point; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a bent guide wheel caught on a damaged section of track; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they replaced the wheel and tested a complete dome rotation, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
